evidence.claim: API uses a base URL and authentication methods including bot tokens.
evidence.quote: Authenticating with the Discord API can be done in one of three ways: Using a bot token found on the Bot page within your app’s settings.

evidence.claim: Discord supports incoming webhooks and webhook events.
evidence.quote: Discord supports two distinct types of webhooks that work in opposite directions: incoming webhooks for posting messages into Discord, and webhook events for receiving notifications from Discord when something happens in your app.
